title: Forensic Audit of the MillenniumLean Clay-Proof Package (AIX Global)
description:
Statement-level forensic audit of the MillenniumLean package (AIX Global, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.22226553), which claims kernel-checked Lean 4 proofs of the six remaining Clay Millennium Problems. The audit independently reproduces every kernel-hygiene claim (clean build, zero sorry, zero project axioms, axiom footprints within the classical trio) under the pinned toolchain leanprover/lean4:v4.34.0-rc1 and mathlib revision d0be1efe9a, then audits what the theorem types actually say against the official Clay statements. Verdict: the package resolves none of the six problems. Findings F01-F14: the claimed final theorems are conditional implications whose unproved premise binders carry the open problems (Riemann, Yang-Mills, P vs NP), definitions of the open statements (Navier-Stokes, BSD), or true theorems about unrelated objects (Hodge: a list identity); the universalization tower proves only 0 < n + 1. All 259 quoted lines verified byte-exact against the package; a three-lane hostile red-team pass was run on the audit itself before publication.

Code MIT licensed. This record is the publication archive for github.com/docxology/millennium_audit.
